reason: Edge is strictly intraday (capitulation, right-side-of-V, order-flow, 1-5 min setups) and does not survive daily-bar approximation.

universe.description: US equities, focus on volatile names with news/earnings/panic

setup.rule: find broken slot machine offering edge
setup.quote: you want to find if you go into a casino you don't want to sit down at the roulette table... the reality is is that's what a lot of people do

setup.rule: wait for right side of V
setup.quote: you can buy in two different times the same price and in those different times they will have drastically different expected value

entry.rule: break of prior bar highs on 2-min chart or moving average after flush
entry.quote: what i might use is is things like a break of prior bar highs on my two minute chart

stop.rule: prior bar lows once on right side of V
stop.quote: first of all you now have a stop in that you can use at lowe's as opposed to no stop when you're buying on the way down

exits.rule: exponential sizing on A+ setups only
exits.quote: when you get those pocket aces they are not betting linearly

sizing.rule: exponential bet sizing on best setups
sizing.quote: on those specific special really exceptional hands you need to bet exponentially

market_filter.rule: do not fight trend; need alignment across timeframes
market_filter.quote: i needed to be a buy on the intraday i needed to be a buy on the daily i want everybody on every time frame screaming by

ambiguities.issue: mentions daily charts in prep but all execution intraday
